name: wiki-plugin-pod
description: Federated Wiki - Pod Plugin — gather configurable pods of related wiki sites (sisters, parent, children, descendants, farm, neighbourhood) into your neighborhood, drawn as rosters
author: David Bovill

plugins.why: pod ships no server of its own: the Farm Plugin mounts its specification and handlers at /system/api/pod/roll.json, which is where the item reads its disk-derived pods.
pod draws nothing itself: a gather is a roster, and the roster plugin already draws one on every wiki, so pod builds the roster text and hands it over.
TWIN and WATCH were split out of pod at 1.2.0; without it those words still parse and say where they went, but nothing shows which sites hold or forked the page.
